summary.text: Sonya Hicks is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Sam Wengryn.
She defeated Paul Davis in the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, and she ran for the same seat in 2024, losing to Wengryn with 32.9 percent of the vote.
